nativeSkills.instructions:
# Swayframe Core Execution V1

Use only capabilities discovered in the current SF runtime. Compile intentions through registered semantic actions or simple native tools. Use actual existing/selection/stepResult references; never invent UUIDs. Validate task dependencies before executing. Defer future outputs until the real producer completes. Every write uses the existing AgentTransaction and Command System. Recover only through the shared bounded controller; never replay completed creation steps or widen scope. Verify commands and draft state, then native rendered output; without vision mark visual comparison NOT VERIFIED. Commit once only after verification and user approval where required.

# Shape Creation V1

Create editable native geometry using actual composition bounds. Bind each result independently; preserve names, shape alpha and geometry. Never create graph generators as substitute shapes.

# Typography V1

Create actual editable Text layers. Keep exact content including Chinese; use real family names and shared font-size ranges. Center placement uses composition pixels. Verify text geometry and native rendering, never assume a particular external font exists.

# Keyframe Animation V1

Use actual layer Property paths or inspected property IDs. Times in seconds within duration. Validate keyframe values and shared interpolation/motion-curve format. Verify endpoints and evaluation. Local changes preserve unrelated text and animation.

For standard timing use animateLayerProperty easing=linear/easeIn/easeOut/easeInOut (host native presets). An explicit bezier interpolation stores BOTH control points of the outgoing normalized segment. Never assign incoming y=0 to the first key and outgoing y=1 to the second: that does not produce ease-in-out. Verify midpoint as well as endpoints.
